target_description: Average room turnover time in minutes between consecutive cases — wheels out to wheels in for the same OR room.

x_labels: Category 0: Procedure could be delayed for 3 months without undue risk
Category 1: SDS with discharge from SPA on the day of surgery
Category 2: SDS with 23 hour stay in non-COVID-19 unit
Category 3: Inpatient stay < = 3 days without ICU care or prolonged ventilation.  Admission to non-COVID-19 unit
Category 4: Inpatient stay > 3 days without ICU care or prolonged ventilation.   Admission to a non-COVID-19 unit
Category 5: Inpatient stay with ICU care or prolonged ventilation.   Admission to non-COVID-19 ICU
